reviews.text:
Dr. Farmer and his team are excellent. They are always thorough, attentive, and take the time to explain everything clearly. One of my dogs is very fearful of strangers, and they have been incredibly patient and gentle with her, which has made a huge difference in her comfort level during visits.

I've never felt pressured into unnecessary tests, treatments, or products. Instead, they focus on what’s best for my pets and always provide clear recommendations and a practical care plan. The pricing is fair, and I appreciate their honesty and transparency.

I'm so grateful to have his practice in the neighborhood. Finding a vet you trust isn't always easy, and Dr. Farmer and his team have earned mine.
Wonderful vet with great staff
Staff all the way around very polite and inviting for my first visit with my cat.
Love this place been taking Gidget here for years everytime she has allergies, they help out a lot she’s back to normal I high recommend it here

I was freaking out because my cat licked herself so much that her tail was exposed.. after waiting 3 hours and still being turned away at a different vet, EaDo vet clinic squeezed me in and provided my cat with a number of solutions, I am very happy with the care they gave my cat and will definitely make this my go to vet.. thank you so much to the staff!

I don’t usually leave bad reviews but I feel like I have to for this one. I’ve been coming to EaDo Veterinary for a couple of years now for both my dog and cat. I have never had issues bringing my dog but my cat is another story. He gets chronic ear infections and I’ve had to bring him a couple of times and have them take a look. The last time was a bit of a nightmare. The doctor ended up using a single dose medication that was way too strong for my cat (did my research and read that the single dose is only meant for dogs) and my cat had the worst reaction. He developed a tongue ulcer so bad that he couldn’t eat on his own and couldn’t bathe himself. He didn’t eat for days and when I took him back first thing on Monday (this happened over the weekend) the vet was asking “did he have this ulcer before?” like they hadn’t checked him a couple of days prior. I know they were aware that the medication is what gave him the ulcer. I was very calm about it and they cleaned his ear out and sent him home with medicine, not to mention I had to pay for the medication after THEY had caused his new issues. Anyways, even after all of this, I wanted to give them a second chance and when my cat started having issues again with his ear I called them first thing in the morning and asked them what to do, next steps or if I could even just pick up medicine. The lady on the phone said she’d reach out to the doctor and ask him and when I called midday yesterday she said she still hadn’t asked him. Anyways it’s day 2 and I still haven’t received a call back so I decided to take my cat elsewhere. I am just shocked at the lack of importance they give someone who has been coming for a while. Even just a call back for a quick update would’ve sufficed. It seems like this vet office is better for dogs and wouldn’t advice bringing your cats here.
Such amazing staff. Very sweet and helpful. Dr. Farmer is the best.

My ~70 lb mixed breed dog has been dealing with a chronic ear infection, old age at 12 years old, and anxiety from our temporary relocation to Houston from Dallas.

We've visited many vets through his lifetime, and we sort of accepted that there is very little we can do about his ear infections. This clinic changed that  completely. They take the time to really get to know you and your pet and to really educate you on more than you even knew you needed to know.

After only a week of treatment since our first visit, my dog's ear infection, anxiety, and mobility have all improved to the point that it's all hardly even noticeable now.

...and they don't nickel and dime you. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic and only wish now that they were DFW based since we'll only be here for a couple months. Dr. Farmer recognized that and proactively told me to call for advice or guidance any time. They treat you and your pet like their own family.

This was my first visit—and definitely my last. I had a scheduled appointment and was turned away at the door because they decided to prioritize another case and didn’t have enough staff. Emergencies happen, but completely dismissing a scheduled client with zero notice is unacceptable.
No call ahead, no attempt to reschedule properly, no real solution—just a casual “come back later” after I had already gone out of my way to be there. That’s not how you run a professional practice.
This clinic clearly does not respect people’s time. Completely disorganized and a total waste of my trip. I would not recommend them to anyone.

My dog is turning 21 years this fall, and traveling to the Gulf Coast ophthalmologist for her glaucoma checks has become too hard on her. After calling several clinics near downtown Houston, I found only two with a tonometer to measure intraocular pressure—EaDo Veterinary Clinic was one of them.
Dr. Farmer was exceptional. My dog is blind and terrified of males, especially in stressful vet environments. But he spoke in a soft, whisper-like tone that soothed her instantly. She usually trembles through appointments, but not in this visit.  Now I am thinking of switching my cat's vet to EaDo vet.
Staff is friendly and the wait time is pretty fast. Love the location!
Awesome clinic.  They truly care about finding the root cause to your pets health and the well being of your baby.

We recently moved to this side of town and have been shopping around for a new vet for our 3 cats. We stumbled upon Eado Vet Clinic and we are so thankful that we did. Dr. Farmer is so warm and kind to our animals. I love when going to vet doesn’t feel clinical, but is instead more personable, and that’s been our experience for every visit. He and the vet techs have been so great with my jumpy and quirky cats. We feel very grateful to have this facility in our neighborhood!

Absolutely horrible customer service.

About six months ago I made an appt to get an allergy shot for my dog.  I came in and was told that they gave my shot away to another dog that was scene before me.

Today I called to make another appt for the allergy shot, got it scheduled for tomorrow and I asked if they could just double check to make sure they have the medicine since this happened before.

Waited on hold for 10 mins then someone else picked up, explained the whole situation again and she said, oh that medication is on back order and we are not sure when we will get it in again.

So why did the receptionist schedule an appointment.

So now I need to go to another vet and play for a $90 physical to get the $90 shot.

Don't waste your time with this place.

Dr. Farmer, the ladies who work up front, and all of the techs are so friendly and welcoming! Dr. Farmer helped get our cat's back healed when others couldn't and now he and the whole crew will watch our new puppy grow up. We love this place and our fur babies do too.
10 out of 10! They were able to squeeze me in to get my boy taken care of before I headed out of town. So extremely grateful!
Excellent attention, quick and knowledgeable. Price is a little more but decent. My calico felt really comfortable with Sarabi.

Dr. Farmer and his staff are knowledgeable, friendly and compassionate. Their customer service is top-notch! We had been taking our fur babies there for years and would not trust them with anyone else.
Everyone was very friendly and knowledgeable. Prices are very reasonable and they have a customer for life!

Much like most furry friend owners, my dogs will always be my babies. When I moved to Houston, I "shopped" around a wee bit trying to find a Vet that I felt was knowledgeable but also supportive of my Chihuahuas who are known to be a little spicy.

EADO Vet Clinic went ABOVE and BEYOND for the 5+ years I went there with my three Chihuahuas. From the moment I walked in, the front desk staff was always incredibly friendly, welcoming, positive, and professional. The waiting room is VERY clean and there was never a time where it felt too chaotic with too many guests.

All of the nurses and doctors were quick to come in the rooms for appointments. They really individualized the care they provided for my dogs, and they took the time to explain the why behind the what to me to ensure I understood what was happening (good and bad). One of my small dogs can also be a little vicious, and they were very calm and understanding with her temperament.

Bonus shout out is how quick they answer any questions, refill prescriptions, and provided any records I needed for groomers.
They really run an extraordinary clinic that leads with customers feeling like family. <3
Dr. Farmer and the staff are great! My dog loves visiting every time. Reasonable pricing.

My pup loves this place. Dr.Farmer and his team have taken such good care of my pup for that reason he is always so happy when we come for a check up or for any of his needs. The price is very reasonable, the care is extraordinary, the staff is kind and amazing. Would highly recommend and encourage pet owners to give this place a shot.

With a friend.
Went in crying for his dog, went out smiling!
And the dog too!!!!

Wally Jo's THUMBS-UP
Dr Farmer and his team are extremely caring and a great Veterinarian Practice. Highly recommend taking your pets to him

The worst vet ever. My dog was screaming in pain, her rabies vaccine lot and expiration date was not given, he nails were not cut her rash was ignored, then on top of it her anal glands werent expressed fully and she came back in the room with me freaked out scared.  They never gave me proof of rabies vaccine so I needed to pay another vet. They also didnt clean her ears at all. She had an infection. She was a rescue from BARC. they ignored everything I brought her in to do then charged me over 500 to do nothing. DO NOT GO TO THIS VET

I wish I could take my animals here since it is the nearest vet and maybe that’ll be the case in the future, but until they get with the times and get a website that provides an actual function like making an appointment or viewing your pets records then I’ll be taking my business elsewhere unfortunately.
I’ll check back in a few months.

After years of searching for a vet clinic that could handle my anxious pittie that HATES vets, they handled my baby with so much care & are so affordable compared to most vets in the area. Thank you all so much!
Best vet in town

Dr. Farmer is the nicest, most compassionate vet I’ve ever worked with. The level of care he exudes towards every animal he works with is  heartwarming. Two of my dogs have been treated here and I’ve recommended many more. I’m lucky to live close by but will continue to bring my animals here even if I move across town. Highly recommend EaDo Vet Clinic!
Dr. Farmer and his staff are A+! Especially Michelle! They're been so great to my Doberman, Taco, during his complications. Highly recommended

Dr. Farmer must have a full ride scholarship to heaven. My sweet 10 year old lab needed surgery. Dr. Farmer really helped calm my nerves by explaining everything to me. He is very gentle and caring.
The staff here is also very friendly.
This is also the cheapest vet I ever got the pleasure of taking my dogs to.

I euthanized my cat here, and now I bring my 3 puppies here. Doctor is definitely considerate and sympathetic. He treats my puppies like his. Staffs also seem to heart-fully love animals. When I had to euthanize my cat, they got suspicious, which I took it as a positive thing because that should be the natural response for animal lover, and it was my first visit to them (I moved from a different State, so my cat’s vet wasn’t this doctor). They understood in the end after I explained to them the medical history of my cat and his unrecoverable condition. Bottom lines, I am very happy with this place. I wish the price was lower, but that’s every customer’s wish lol. With the convenience of its location and their level of care, I cannot complain.

We came here because our dog had a hangnail. The staff was really nice and helpful.  They took Hope to the back and removed it. She came back all happy and trotting.  The doctor came v back and explained everything. I really like this place.  And it's not more expensive than any other veterinary.

I have moved all over the Houston area in the last five years, but no matter how far away I am I always come back to Eado Vet Clinic. Their veterinarians are the absolute best and you can tell they really care about the pet and the owners, especially Dr. Farmer, who has taken care of all my babies through some rough times. Their prices are very fair as well. As someone who used to work as a vet tech in other clinics for many years, I fully trust them with my babies and I highly recommend them to my friends and anyone in the Houston area!
Excellent vet. Caring, thorough, and trustworthy.
Very caring and knowledgeable vet. She and her team rock, or should I say Bark amo get the best. Glad EaDo vet is here.
Si far a great experience ! I took my 10 year old dog for a check; the doctor was very professional and took the time to explain everything in detail. Prices are reasonable as well

We’re so grateful a friend recommended Dr. Farmer and Dr. Solis — they’ve been incredible from day one. They’re thorough, thoughtful, and always willing to work us in when our dog needs urgent care. Their front desk staff is welcoming and organized, making every interaction easy and pleasant. They also follow up after visits to check in, which really shows their dedication. Plus, their pricing is very fair for the high-quality care they offer. We wouldn’t trust our pet with anyone else!

Dr. Farmer and Dr. Solis provide the most compassionate and attentive care we could ever ask for. They’re incredibly diligent with their exams, making sure every detail is covered and explained. When our dog had an urgent issue, they made room in their schedule right away, and their follow-up afterward showed how much they truly care. Their front desk staff is kind, efficient, and always helpful, making every visit smooth and stress-free. On top of that, their prices are very reasonable for the outstanding care they provide. We feel so lucky to have found them!
Love the staff here, especially Dr Farmer who is always so patient and takes the time to take care of our babies

We reached out to inquire about establishing care with a new vet in our area. Unfortunately, their earliest available appointment is in seven days, so we've decided to explore other options that are more accommodating.
Dr. Farmer is so good with our deaf dog Alfred, we really appreciate his care and concern for his special needs!
Thank you for seeing Lola today without an appointment. We are making this our new vet office. Dr. And staff were very friendly.
Dr. Farmer is the best. Smart, friendly, and informative
If you're around downtown HTX, this is the place. I took my lab there and they got us in quickly and fixed us up fast.  Highly recommend this place - So does @romanthebeach
Great staff , great service
Dr. Farmer and his staff are amazing!  Over the years, he and his team have provided excellent care for our two Miniature Schnauzers and our Giant Schnauzer.
Very gentle with our anxious doggo!
